definition: The process of managing relationships, communications, and deliverables with clients or customers.
extendedDefinition: Effective client management goes beyond scheduling meetings: it encompasses clear communication of scope, proactive reporting, expectation-setting, and consistent follow-through on deliverables. Teams that manage clients well typically track project milestones, payment terms, feedback cycles, and contract renewals in a single view. Dedicated client management software centralizes contact history, tasks, invoices, and documents so that no detail is lost between stakeholders. The discipline matters most during onboarding, when early clarity about responsibilities and timelines shapes the whole relationship. For service businesses, strong client management directly improves retention, repeat revenue, and referral rates, because satisfied clients are more willing to renew contracts and expand engagements. Buyers evaluating tools should look for pipeline visibility, automation of follow-ups, and reporting that keeps both internal leadership and external stakeholders informed.
description: Client Management. The process of managing relationships, communications, and deliverables with clients or customers.
